drafts.subject: Goods receipt needed: PO 4500012163 line 10 (Point Henry Labels, invoice PHL-05033)
drafts.body:
Hi team,

Point Henry Labels has invoiced us on PO 4500012163 (invoice PHL-05033, $2,772.00 inc GST) for 120 x 1000 of PS label 100x150 (PO line 10). No goods receipt has been recorded against that line.

Could you please check whether this delivery has arrived?

- If it has, please post the goods receipt so we can pay the invoice.
- If it hasn't, please let AP know and we will query the vendor.

The buyer on the PO is R. Delaney if you need to check the order details.

Thanks,
Accounts Payable
